readerCopy.body: An old source of control can become easier to name without being allowed to run the current decision. When Pluto sextiles Lilith, power and autonomy cooperate, making a private rule, unequal agreement, buried resentment, or fear of punishment easier to see without taking over the entire situation. That creates room for a correction that is firm without becoming revenge. The point is to make the arrangement different now, not to keep every new choice organized around winning the old fight.
